homePage.appDescription: Welcome to formAT, the ultimate form builder and survey tool! Whether you're gathering feedback, conducting research, or collecting data, formAT has you covered.

stats.usersDesc: Are you a form creator or a form filler? Join our community of users who are shaping the future of information gathering with formAT.
stats.formsDesc: What kind of bread are you? Which cat breed is the best? Explore the variety of forms created with formAT.
stats.submissionsDesc: How many times have people hit submit? Discover the engagement and impact of forms created with formAT.

features.advancedFormBuilderDesc: Create complex forms with various question types. Make them public or private. Customize with shuffle options and add images and banners.
features.liveResultsDesc: Browse your form submissions in real time. See how people are responding to your questions and get instant feedback and statistics.
features.rateAndReviewDesc: Share your thoughts and opinions on forms created by others. Rate and review forms to help creators improve and to guide other users in finding the best forms for their needs.
